notes: 38 units cover all 40 source ids (two fused waw+negative pairs) and all 47 target ids.

*neither* (s009+s013) and *nor* (s031+s035) are rule 35 fusions of a waw with a following negative, each headed on the negative. They are not a *neither … nor* correlative pair under rule 14: they belong to different clause sequences, and each of the two clauses they open writes no separate *not* of its own.

s019 אוֹתָךְ takes *are with*: the ASV spends a word on the relation, and the verbless clause's copula joins the prepositional predicate (rules 16, 49), headed on *with*. The same tokens follow if the form is read as the preposition H854 under rule 11.
מִפְּנֵיהֶם is correctly split rather than fused — the ASV spends *at* on מִן and *looks* on פָּנֶה, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 applies.
Each verb of *be afraid* heads on *afraid* under rule 44, with the unit discontinuous around a written *not* where one stands (rule 25).
